name: Crânio de Onça - Porção Dorsal
description:
Modelo 3D de crânio de onça (Panthera onca), integrante da Coleção Didática do Laboratório de Anatomia Comparada de Vertebrados (LACV), Universidade de Brasília (UnB). O modelo apresenta a identificação de alguns elementos ósseos, permitindo a observação de características morfológicas típicas da família Felidae, como crânio robusto e dentição adaptada à predação. 

A onça é o maior felino das Américas e desempenha papel fundamental como predador de topo, regulando populações de presas e contribuindo para a manutenção do equilíbrio ecológico. Trata-se de um dos principais representantes da fauna do Cerrado, um dos biomas mais biodiversos do Brasil.

Autoria: Maria Eduarda Rodrigues da Silva (UnB/LACV).

name: Umbrathal - monster whale
description:
**The Dread of Umbrathal, the Siren Leviathan**

Beneath the ink-black waters of the Sunless Trench, where light has never touched and pressure crushes bones like glass, *Umbrathal* stirs. This whale is no gentle giant—it is a cathedral of flesh, its body riddled with barnacle-covered mouths that whisper in forgotten dialects. Its eyes are absent, replaced by pulsing voids that see into memory.

Umbrathal was born when a whaling crew slaughtered a pod beneath a blood moon, their greed echoing through the abyss. The sea answered. It stitched the dead into one, a leviathan of vengeance and sorrow. Now it rises only when the ocean is still, its song a low, mournful hum that infects dreams and draws ships off course.

It feeds on *remembrance*. Survivors speak of hallucinations—lost lovers beckoning from the waves, childhood homes glimpsed in the mist—before the hull splits and the sea drinks them whole. No wreckage floats. Only silence. And the echo of Umbrathal’s song, still humming in the bones of the drowned.

name: Larinioides sclopetarius
description:
Larinioides sclopetarius (Clerck, 1757) — Bridge Orbweaver

This 3D model depicts a male Larinioides sclopetarius specimen, collected in Scarborough, Ontario, Canada in 2025. It was reconstructed from a dissected specimen to highlight details of this widespread orbweaving spider.

Textures & Workflow:
Surface textures were created using a hybrid method—combining procedural generation with stencils from high-resolution images captured via a 12MP Raspberry Pi camera mounted on a vintage JENA stereoscope.

Species Overview:
Native to Europe and now common in North America, especially near bridges and waterfronts, L. sclopetarius builds orb-shaped webs and thrives in urban environments. Males are smaller and more mobile, especially during mating season.

Use & Availability:
This model supports education and outreach on Canadian spider diversity.

Available for purchase.
For licensing or inquiries, please contact the artist/seller.

name: Northfield Historical Society Mastodon Tooth
description:
This 3D scan is the result of a collaboration between the Science Museum of Minnesota and the good people of [Northfield Historical Society](http://https://www.northfieldhistory.org/) in Northfield, Minnesota. 

This tooth is one of the few mastodon fossils in the record that we know for sure was discovered in Minnesota. It has research value to the Science Museum of Minnesota, and the folks at Northfield Historical Society were generous and willing to allow their mastodon tooth to be 3D scanned by me. 
Thank you, [Northfield Historical Society!](http://https://www.instagram.com/northfieldhistorical/) 

Specimen Number 1980.15.01. This fossil was discovered in 1918 by a man named Leslie Shaw in "Mr. Cody's Gravel Pit" outside of Dundas, Minnesota. It sat in Mr. Shaw's living room for a few years before being taken to Professor Osborn of Hamline University in 1929. Professor Osborn Identified the fossil as a [mastodon](http://https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mastodon) tooth. 100 years later: we agree!

name: Iguanodon Bernissartensis
description: Iguanodon (/ɪˈɡwɑːnədɒn/ i-GWAH-nə-don; meaning 'iguana-tooth'), named in 1825, is a genus of iguanodontian dinosaur. While many species found worldwide have been classified in the genus Iguanodon, dating from the Late Jurassic to Early Cretaceous, taxonomic revision in the early 21st century has defined Iguanodon to be based on one well-substantiated species: I. bernissartensis, which lived during the Barremian to early Aptian ages of the Early Cretaceous in Belgium, Germany, England, and Spain, between about 126 and 122 million years ago. Iguanodon was a large, bulky herbivore, measuring up to 9–11 metres (30–36 ft) in length and 4.5 metric tons (5.0 short tons) in body mass. Distinctive features include large thumb spikes, which were possibly used for defense against predators, combined with long prehensile fifth fingers able to forage for food.

Chrysiridia rhipheus, the Madagascan sunset moth, is a species of day-flying moth of the family Uraniidae. It is considered one of the most impressive and appealing-looking lepidopterans. Famous worldwide, it is featured in most coffee table books on Lepidoptera and is much sought after by collectors, though many older sources misspell the species name as "ripheus". name: Black Myth: Wukong - Kang Jin Long [Static]
description:
Kang Jin Long - Introduction

Kang Jin Long, belonging to the dragon, is Kang. Protected by the big horn, it is one of the twenty-eight constellations in Chinese mythology and the second constellation in the east. It is the god of wind, like a fire bead, located at the neck position in the Canglong constellation, and is the essence of the Canglong, so it is named Kangjinlong. Its appearance and temperament are similar to those of a dragon. It is long, has scales, can fly, and is good at walking. In ancient books, people often see it playing in the water.

In "The Romance of the Gods", its original name is Li Daotong. After being killed in the Ten Thousand Immortals Formation, it was deified.

In "Journey to the West", it once helped Sun Wukong escape from the golden cymbals.

name: Triceratops horridus
description:
One of the most iconic dinosaurs, the name *Triceratops* means "3 horned face" in reference to its three face horns. Triceratops was among the largest of the ceratopsians, weighing in at about 6-8 tons. As well, it was one of the last ceratopsians, living about 68-66 mya, just before the K-Pg Mass Extinction. This puts it at the same time frane as Tyrannosaurus rex. Evidence shows that these two animals had a predator prey relationship

The species here is *Triceratops horridus*, the older of the two species, the younger one being *Triceratops prorsus*.

name: オキナワイシダタミ / Monodonta labio
description:
螺塔は正円錐形で、その輪郭は直線的。殻表は太い螺肋と縦溝がまじりあって、名前のように石畳状。色彩は黄褐色～緑褐色の地に白、褐色、濃紺などの斑点を散らす。奄美諸島以南、潮間帯岩礁。

The shell is a regular cone with a straight outline. The surface features a mixture of thick whorls and longitudinal grooves, giving it a cobblestone-like appearance, as its name suggests.  (Its Japanese name is Okinawa Ishidatami, meaning “Okinawa stone pavement” ). The coloration consists of a yellowish-brown to greenish-brown background speckled with white, brown, and dark blue spots. Found on rocky reefs in the intertidal zone south of the Amami Islands.

和名：オキナワイシダタミ

英名：Monodonta labio

学名：Monodonta labio labio (Linnaeus, 1758)    ニシキウズ科　Trochidae

殻長：1cm

参考文献：「日本近海産貝類図鑑」【第二版】奥谷喬司 編著 東海大学出版部（2017年1月）

References：Illustrated Guide to Shellfish of Japanese Coastal Waters [Second Edition] Edited by Takashi Okutani Tokai University Press (January 2017)

name: the muru ( T Pose + made in paints 3d )
description:
In the oral traditions of Chile’s coastal regions, particularly among Mapuche communities, there exists a long-whispered legend of ghostly beings that walk the shores before and during catastrophes. These entities had no formal name for centuries - only described in fragments and murmurs passed from survivor to survivor.

It wasn’t until the 27F Earthquake in 2010 that a term gained traction: “Muru”, a word meaning complaint or warning in Mapudungun. Survivors, particularly in Talcahuano, Dichato, and Curanilahue, began using this term to refer to the strange, faceless entities seen walking in the waves before the tsunami struck.

name: Apatosaurus
description:
Apatosaurus: The Thunderous Giant of the Jurassic

Apatosaurus was a massive, long-necked sauropod that roamed North America during the Late Jurassic period, around 152 million years ago. Measuring up to 75 feet long and weighing as much as 22 tons, this giant herbivore used its long neck to reach vegetation high in trees and its powerful tail, possibly as a whip for defense against predators like Allosaurus. Despite its enormous size, Apatosaurus moved on four sturdy legs and likely lived in herds, offering protection through numbers. Often confused with Brontosaurus, Apatosaurus remains one of the most iconic dinosaurs, showcasing the sheer scale of prehistoric life.

name: Etruscan seal (digit III of right front flipper)
description:
3D scan of digit III (right front flipper) of the Etruscan seal.

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

The "Young Tyrannosaurus Rex"(T-Rex) figure from the 1993 Jurassic Park toy line by Kenner is a highly regarded collectible. This toy features a distinctive "dino damage" mechanism, where a piece of skin can be removed to reveal the ribs underneath. name: ULTRA_MEGALODON
description: Megalodon was a massive prehistoric shark that lived approximately 23 to 3.6 million years ago, during the Miocene to Pliocene epochs. It is one of the largest and most powerful predators in history, estimated to reach lengths of up to 18 meters (59 feet) or more. Megalodon had enormous, serrated teeth, some over 18 cm (7 inches) long, ideal for slicing through large prey like whales and other marine mammals. It had a broad, powerful body and jaws capable of exerting a bite force much stronger than that of modern great white sharks. Fossils of Megalodon have been found worldwide, revealing its presence in ancient oceans across various regions.

name: Tyrannosaurus rex
description: Tyrannosaurus (/tɪˌrænəˈsɔːrəs, taɪ-/)[a] is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The type species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning 'king' in Latin), often shortened to T. rex or colloquially t-rex, is one of the best represented theropods. It lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of geological formations dating to the late Maastrichtian age of the late Cretaceous period, 69 to 66 million years ago, with isolated specimens possibly indicating an earlier origin in the middle Campanian age. It was one of the last known members of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.

name: Remains of the railway bridge over the Varėnė
description:
Remains of the railway bridge over the Varėnė Photogrammetry reconstruction.

The Varėna-Alytus railway crossed the Varėnė River behind the Artillery Station, so a bridge about 21 m long was built across it in 1894. The bridge was blown up by the retreating Tsarist army in 1915, but the Kaiser’s army quickly rebuilt it. The remains of a wooden span can still be seen on the site of the former railway bridge over the Varėnė River - wooden piles can be clearly seen on the site of the former bridge as you walk across the footbridge.

📸 The model was processed in RealityScan from 1235 high-resolution photos.

Created as part of the project:

“Fort-Union – Integration of the Polish–Lithuanian Network of Fortifications for the Development of Representative Tourism Products”

name: Fontana comune "Grimaldina", Campagna (SA)
description:
Teodoro: "Una delle fontane pubbliche di Campagna, piccolo borgo adagiato alla base del monte Polveracchio, nel Salernitano.

Al paese torno ogni estate da quando sono piccolo. È il posto dei miei genitori e parenti, dove ho lasciato pezzi di infanzia e adolescenza, dove vivono amici che sento vicino nonostante i chilometri che ci separano. Per anni sono stato una figura a metà, una presenza stagionale che forse non ha mai visto il paese nella sua normalità quotidiana. Eppure qualcosa di Campagna non me lo sono mai scrollato di dosso.
D'estate, quando i monti regalano frescura e la gente esce dopo cena, il corso si anima e il largo Sant'Antonio diventa il punto d'arrivo. Ci si ferma, si chiacchiera, si perde il conto del tempo.
Il paese nel tempo è cambiato, e con lui le persone. Chi è rimasto a costruirsi una vita lì, chi è andato a cercare fortuna altrove. Ma la fontana è sempre lì, uguale a sé stessa, e ogni volta che la rivedo capisco che certi punti fermi non hanno bisogno di spiegazioni."

Tràth san fhicheadamh linn sheall cladhaich arc-eòlach gun do thòisich am baile eadar 500 BC agus 200 BC.

Tha modail Beurla ri fhaighinn [an seo](https://skfb.ly/oRpZB).

description:
Палацово-парковий комплекс у Христинополі спроєктований французьким інженером та архітектором П’єром Ріко де Тіррґеєм (фр. Pierre Ricaud de Tirregaille) на замовлення польського магната, претендента на корону Францішека Салезія Потоцького (1700-1772 рр.). 
Палац постав у 1756-1762 роках на місці родинного замку, що існував тут з середини XVII ст. Христинопільську резиденцію Потоцьких, що поєднувала стилі бароко та ранній класицизм, вважали перлиною палацової архітектури Речі Посполитої, що не поступалася вишуканістю королівському палацу у Вілянуві поблизу Варшави. 
У 1951 році внаслідок договору про обмін територіями між Республікою Польща та СРСР Христинопіль переходить під юрисдикцію Радянського Союзу. Місто швидко розвивається, перетворюючись на потужний індустріальний центр. На тлі цих змін нова комуністична влада не надто переймалася збереженням історичної спадщини і до 1967 року браму палацу повністю розібрали, а на її місці збудували сучасну будівлю школи №4 нового шахтарського міста.

name: Brennanstown Portal Tomb (DU026-007----)
description: National Monument No. 291. Portal tomb on the flat valley floor of Druid's Glen, 15m to the north of the Carrickmines River, Brennanstown (Baile Uí Bhraonáin), Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown, Dublin. A wedge-shaped granite roofstone measuring 5.1m long by 4.5m wide by 1.75m thick, covers a chamber measuring internally 3.1m long by 1.42m wide with antechamber facing east. The roofstone rests on two west facing portal stones (H 2.6m & 2m respectively) & two sidestones. A backstone separates the main chamber from the subsidiary chamber. There are three granite stones set on edge which may from part of a second chamber to the east.  Monument type defined by the ASI as; 'A single, short chamber formed by two tall portal-stones, two sidestones and a backstone. Sometimes a stone between the portals closes the entry. The chamber is covered by a roofstone, often of enormous size, which slopes down from the front towards the rear. Cremation was the preferred burial rite and these date to the Neolithic from 3800 to 3200 BC'.

description:
Point cloud data is a 3D data set made up of a large number of points. They can be obtained using 3D laser scanners or other methods. Point cloud data is widely used in surveying and mapping, building renovation and archaeological remains. They can capture 3D measurements of real objects with precision and detail, and be seamlessly integrated into CAD projects for accurate modeling and design. It helps users get information faster, reduce errors and improve design accuracy.
In ZWCAD 2024, the Point Cloud function lets you smoothly read and process complex point cloud data. It can display up to 50 million points simultaneously, almost twice as many as the competition. What's more, this module offers a host of useful functions to meet a variety of needs
Seamless file import
You can effortlessly import point cloud files by attaching them as external references. It currently supports a wide range of file formats, including RCS, RCP, E57, LAS, LAZ and PTS.

name: Geoglyph of Konkan - Elephant, Ukshi
description:
# Geoglyphs of Konkan Region of India

> *Geoglyphs are rock art produced on the surface earth either by positioning rocks, rock fragments or by reduction technique i.e. carving out or removing part of a rock surface to form a design. The large concentration of geoglyphs on the laterite plateaus (Sada) of the Konkan region (south western Maharashtra to Southern Karnataka) is the most remarkable open-air ensemble of prehistoric human expression of rock art in the Konkan region (south western Maharashtra to Southern Karnataka) from Mesolithic (10Kya) to Early Historic (1.7Kya.*).

> *A large figure of an Indian male elephant (6 x 5.40 m) is a geoglyph located in Ukshi, Maharashtra. The head of the elephant is in profile as two ears marked with cross motif are clearly seen. Two long jutting out teeth are clearly illustrated on both sides of a long hanging trunk. Pointed tail, trunk, tip and teeth remain other features of stylization.*

**Attic Column Krater (ca. 460 BCE)**

This 3D model depicts an ancient Greek Attic column krater, a vessel used for mixing wine and water during symposia (drinking gatherings). Created around 460 BCE and attributed to the Boreas Painter, the original ceramic vessel is an example of Classical Athenian pottery and reflects the social and artistic traditions of ancient Greece.

name: Amuleto Ispuligadentes: Magico cuore sardo
description:
Amuleto Sardo – Ispuligadentes
L’Ispuligadentes, amuleto tradizionale sardo in argento, presenta una forma a cuore finemente decorata. Al centro, incorniciato, un turchese, pietra associata a protezione e guarigione. Indossato come ornamento, svolgeva una funzione apotropaica: proteggeva dal male e allontanava le influenze negative. Inserito nel contesto della cultura magico-religiosa dell’isola, rientra nella ricca tradizione rituale e simbolica della Sardegna. I motivi ornamentali e la forma evocano concetti profondi come amore, fertilità e forza vitale.

Valore artistico e culturale:
Dal punto di vista artistico, è un raffinato esempio di oreficeria tradizionale: l’argento alterna superfici lisce a dettagli cesellati, con richiami naturalistici. La sua forma armoniosa e il forte simbolismo lo rendono un’opera che coniuga sapientemente estetica, spiritualità e identità culturale sarda. Oggetto di grande fascino, emblema dell’artigianato e del patrimonio immateriale dell’isola.
Alessio Langella – ITI Alghero

name: laplace_beltrami_surface
description:
**Shape Formula, Where:** *Δf = (1/√det(g))·∂i(√det(g)·g^ij·∂j f)*

*Laplace-Beltrami operator, generalized Laplacian on curved surfaces*. 

The Laplace-Beltrami operator is a fundamental mathematical tool that generalizes the simple "Laplacian" you might use on a flat surface (like a spreadsheet) to work on any complex curved shape, such as the surface of a sculpture, a human face model in a computer, or even the surface of the Earth.

It measures how the value of something, be it heat, color, or elevation...changes across a curved landscape, and averages those changes to smooth things out.

**Use**: 
It helps engineers predict the resonant frequencies of a physical object, like how a church bell rings, or how a bridge might vibrate under specific wind conditions. Linking the geometry of the object to its physical behavior.

**Applications**: 
heat diffusion, spectral geometry, shape analysis, machine learning on graphs.

This logo was designed as a tribute to the community as we approach the June 1, 2026 closure of Rec Room. It serves as a final "Maker Pen" project to honor the building and creativity that defined the platform.

The "Hollow" Design
The logo is intentionally designed with a hollow frame. This was done to give you complete creative freedom; because it is a stencil-style cutout, you can easily change the colors or layer different textures and room backgrounds behind it. It is built to be adaptable for any farewell event or archive project.

The Vision
By keeping the design simple and modular, this logo acts as a bridge for creators. While the platform may be closing, the "hollow" space represents the room we’ve made for whatever we build next. It maintains the classic Rec Room spirit while allowing every creator to customize the final look to match their own legacy.

name: Remaining propeller of the Empress of Ireland
description:
Type: Four‑bladed bronze marine propeller
Estimated Diameter: ~5.2 m
Estimated Weight: ~20 tonnes
Vessel: RMS Empress of Ireland (1906‑1914)
Location: Wreck site off Pointe‑au‑Père, Quebec, Canada
Depth: ~40 meters
This propeller is one of two that powered the Canadian Pacific Steamship Company’s transatlantic liner Empress of Ireland. The ship sank in the Saint Lawrence River on the night of May 29, 1914, after colliding with the Norwegian collier Storstad. The disaster claimed the lives of 1,012 of the 1,477 people on board, making it one of the worst maritime tragedies in Canadian history.
Following the sinking, several salvage operations were conducted, mainly to recover mail and silver bullion. In the 1920s, one of the ship’s two propellers was reportedly removed, but its fate remains uncertain. The other propeller, depicted here, remains attached to the wreck and is still visible to experienced technical divers.
This model was made from 297 images.

name: McLaren MP4/8 1993 Senna CLEAN
description:
I make McLaren 1993 F1 Senna Dirty without using ia. My model was created using Blender for modeling and Photoshop for texture refinement.

The development pipeline included the following steps:

High-Poly Model Creation: An initial high-poly version of the model was developed to capture all necessary details.

Texturing: Textures were applied using materials downloaded from https://ambientcg.com/ ensuring high visual quality and Photoshop using UV and masks.

Low-Poly Optimization: The model was then optimized into a low-poly version, suitable for real-time applications.

Texture Baking: Textures were baked from the high-poly model onto the low-poly version, preserving the visual details of the original model while significantly reducing the polygon count.

The result is an optimized model ready for integration into a game environment, striking a perfect balance between visual quality and performance.

name: Ford Thunderbird Convertible – Personal Project
description:
This vehicle was created as a personal project to further develop my hard-surface modeling and texturing skills.

The model was built entirely from scratch in Autodesk 3ds Max, with a strong emphasis on:

*  Clean, production-ready topology.

*  Accurate real-world proportions.

*  Refined surface detailing and panel definition.

The Ford Thunderbird served as the primary reference, supported by additional study of vehicles from the same era to ensure authenticity in form, styling, and material treatment.

All texturing and material work was completed in Substance Painter, utilizing a combination of:

* Procedural masking workflows

* Hand-painted wear and surface variation

The objective was to achieve a realistic, subtly aged appearance, reflecting natural material response and light surface wear while preserving the vehicle’s iconic luxury aesthetic.

**Boeing AH-64E Apache Guardian** hard-surface 3D model created with a focus on realism and accurate mechanical detail. The asset is based on real-world references, capturing correct proportions, structural layout, and functional components of the attack helicopter. The model includes a detailed fuselage, cockpit frame, sensor housing, main and tail rotor assemblies, landing gear, wing stubs, and mounted weapon systems.

Textures feature a realistic military paint scheme with weathering, edge wear, dirt buildup, and surface damage to represent a combat-used aircraft. Materials are designed following a PBR workflow to ensure consistent results across different lighting conditions.

The model is suitable for real-time applications, cinematic renders, military visualization, and portfolio presentation. Clean topology and organized structure make it adaptable for further optimization.

name: CHEVROLET BEL AIR LOWRIDER 1953 3D-printing
description:
This work is based on a Sketchup-file. Unfortunately I don´t remember the name of its author. Anyway, thanks for the great model! Several years ago I converted and repaired it into a watertight STL-file for 3D-printing.

My purpose is to provide watertight STL-files for you, which can easily be modified for 3D-printing, according to your references. Therefore, most of my models are not repaired into one single shell. This may be a bit more difficult for the preparation of the build, but helps you a lot, if you want to personalize the model. E.g. if you want to seperate parts, such as wheels or to remove delicate details like wipers etc.

Before printing, please check out if you have to modify the model, depending on the favored size of your print and the requirements of your printer. I hope you enjoy it. Happy printing!

If you are going to print this model, please feel free to share your experiences about its printability in the comments.

name: Cube Star "Golpe de Ritmo"
description:
Este modelado 3D presenta una figura estilizada y expresiva sosteniendo un martillo en forma de guitarra, fusionando dos ideas opuestas: la delicadeza del arte y la contundencia del impacto. El objeto principal no es solo un instrumento, sino una herramienta de expresión intensa, casi como si cada nota tuviera peso propio.El entorno minimalista, con nubes suaves flotando en el vacío, crea un contraste intencional: calma visual frente a una energía lista para explotar. Los elementos flotantes —iconos, símbolos y formas— refuerzan la idea de que este personaje habita un espacio donde la creatividad no sigue reglas físicas. Los colores vibrantes y acentos neón le dan un aire digital y surrealista, evocando una estética entre dreamcore y videojuego, donde lo absurdo se siente completamente natural.

👀 A su lado, una pequeña figura observa la escena, añadiendo un toque narrativo: ¿es un espectador, un compañero… o el único que entiende lo que está a punto de pasar?

name: Ultraman Max
description:
My English level is not good, all English texts are written by using the translation machine.

This is Bandai Namco's version of the Max 3D model. Previously, someone had publicly uploaded a Max model from a Chinese company called “乐堂” online, I couldn't find anyone publicly sharing Bandai Namco's Max model before this. I found that some people have it, but they don't seem to choose to make it public.

The model is from the mobile game “Ultraman Fusion Fight”, and the textures are from “Ultraman All Star Chronicles”. The textures from Fusion Fight were too blurry, so I used Blender to modify the UVs and replace the textures. The UVs of the two are roughly the same, so adjusting the positions almost perfectly replaced them.

Besides the character model, it also includes models of Max Galaxy and Maxium Sword.

name: Persepolis & The Apadana Palace
description: Persepolis, the ancient capital of ancient Persia and one of the famous historical heritage of Persian Achaemenid Emperor, Cyrus the Great (ca. 600–530 BC). It has been recognised a World Heritage Site by UNESCO since 1979. Persepolis is a vast site and this model includes some parts of it, namely, the entrance stairs, Gate of All Nations, and the Apadana palace. Although many parts of the Persepolis disappeared throughout centuries, the existing relics and figurative frescoes take us back to the ancient times.  Persepolis is situated 60 km from the city of Shiraz in central Iran.

name: Lani (Dandy’s World OC)
description:
This little dingus is based off of one of my Splatoon OCs of the same name. I had a good description, but it got deleted when I went to fix the preview. This model isn't really optimized that well, but I'm 100% sure her old model has a lot more triangles lol

She uses features from Poppy, Gigi, and Glisten. Poppy's head and bubble thing for the hair, Gigi's sweater, and Glisten's legs.

This model came from Prisma3D's gltf exporting feature (FYI: I had to first export as a prisma3d file, then send it to my phone that has modded Prisma3D to export it as a gltf)

Notice: When imported into Blender, she is **very** reflective. To fix that, go to Shading, and set the IOR level down to the lowest setting you can drag it to
